quests.instruction: Listen carefully, then select the word you hear.
quests.hint: For 'ship,' pull your tongue back a little and round your lips slightly; for 'sip,' keep the tongue tip close to your teeth with relaxed lips.
quests.explanation: The speaker said "ship." The /ʃ/ is made further back in the mouth, often with rounded lips. "Sip" would use the /s/, with the tongue tip closer to the teeth and the lips relaxed.
quests.vowelTensionRule: /s/ keeps the tongue tip close to the teeth for a sharp, narrow hiss. /ʃ/ pulls the tongue back, often with rounder lips, for a broader hiss.
